purpose: Preserve failed configured-code-page assumption and a subsequent raw compiler-metadata observation; not an ingestion-defect claim.

failed_checkpoint.expectation: A project configured CodePage28591 over shared ASCII source would always be flow-unavailable.
failed_checkpoint.observed: The original helper received a complete C flow with exit0; the expectation was not justified by configured CodePage alone.

interpretation: Configured code pages and the analyzed Roslyn SourceText encoding differ in this observed linked-workspace case. Shared-workspace reuse may affect actual encoding; subsequent checks capture unchanged raw facts from the same successful engine analysis and validate availability against those actual facts. No retry forces actual mixed encoding groups.
